title: feat(spec): complete FormView protocol with form-presentation props (conformance)
body:
Per the platform-author call: add the genuine *frontend-only* props the conformance check (#2480) surfaced to the spec, so the protocol declares what the `ObjectForm` component actually accepts.

`FormViewSchema` gains (all **optional, additive**) the per-`type` presentation config: `layout`, `columns`, `title`, `description`, `defaultTab`, `tabPosition`, `allowSkip`, `showStepIndicator`, `splitDirection`, `splitSize`, `splitResizable`, `drawerSide`, `drawerWidth`, `modalSize`.

**Result** (re-ran conformance against the live manifest):
- object-form: **15 matched / 6 spec-only / 0 frontend-only** (was 1 / 6 / **14**) — the genuine divergence is eliminated.
- the react-tier contract now **sources these from the spec** (with descriptions) instead of a hand-authored overlay (ObjectForm 14→20 props, regenerated).

Low risk: `view` isn't in the property-liveness GOVERNED set (no liveness decl needed); **6650 spec tests still green**; **api-surface unchanged** (optional fields don't move the tracked surface). The 6 remaining spec-only (data/groups/subforms/defaultSort/sharing/submitBehavior) are metadata config the registry palette doesn't expose as designer inputs — the softer, expected signal.

This is the first concrete step of the architectural principle: **spec = protocol source of truth; the frontend conforms; conformance ratchets it.**
